name: Batch API — Per-line `model` in JSONL
summary: POST /v1/batches wraps other endpoints (chat/completions, responses, embeddings, moderations, videos); each JSONL line's `body.model` is the BYOM slot.
description: The Batch API itself does not take a top-level `model`; instead each JSONL input line contains a full request body for the wrapped endpoint (chat completions, responses, embeddings, moderations, or videos), including that request's own `model`. The BYOM question is whether the batch runner faithfully forwards a `{connection}/{deployment}` prefix down to the wrapped endpoint the same way a live call would, or whether the batch scheduler strips/rewrites the model to something on the Foundry account. Untested — batch jobs run 24 h and are inconvenient to iterate against, which is likely why this hasn't been validated yet.
notes: Status-only. Overlaps with `byom-incompatible-endpoints` rollup, which currently lists batch as not-supported; promote out of the rollup once tested and split into a supported/not-supported outcome.
